findings.label: Reuse can fence a live run
findings.issue: source_intake_chat may pick a chat whose Working Run is live in another process; the CLI's begin() then interrupts it.
findings.action: Skip reuse candidates whose chat has a Working Run with a live lease (run_lease::run_is_live) and fall back to a new chat.

findings.label: Provider-centric failure suffix
findings.issue: "Continue when the provider is ready." is appended for every AiErrorKind, including tool-limit, time-limit, storage, index and unsafe-credential failures, and it persists after restart.
findings.action: Choose the suffix by error kind or use neutral wording; coordinate the final text with the UI agent.

findings.label: Single-snapshot recovery
findings.issue: Two simultaneous orphans in one chat make the second recovery Stale: Resume stays refused until pressed again, and the unretired owner-direct preparation is listed by candidates().
findings.action: Re-read records after each applied recovery, or retire the stale operation.

findings.label: Destructive journey script
findings.issue: The script runs shutil.rmtree(ROOT) on whatever path it is given.
findings.action: Refuse an existing path, or require a fresh directory under the synthetic data root.

findings.label: Contract docs not yet updated
findings.issue: The proposed threads-behavior.md, invariants.md and status.md text exists only in the evidence, and the evidence header still says no product code changed.
findings.action: Apply the contract text at integration and refresh the stale evidence header.

findings.label: Full check not green here
findings.issue: verify-storage.sh stopped at 12 brn-threads-intake sandbox failures in a sandboxed shell; the crate is unchanged.
findings.action: Rerun verify-storage.sh unsandboxed on the combined branch.

findings.label: Mixed builds and cross-process lease
findings.issue: Live Runs from a lease-less build look orphaned, and no two-process lease check was run.
findings.action: Run the combined desktop state suite and a desktop-plus-CLI check from one build, then do the pending native quit observation (not alongside the UI agent).
